interest: Index on the cruiser Ashigara's 1937 visit to Kiel, Germany.
overview: Docket (1937): records on the Japanese cruiser Ashigara's courtesy visit to Kiel after the British Coronation Review.

subfiles.about: A State Department index sheet recording papers filed under classification 894.3362 regarding visits of Japanese naval vessels to German ports in 1937.
subfiles.summary: Lists two 1937 entries on courtesies to the cruiser Ashigara at Kiel, and a Naval Attaché report on German visits.
